title: Amendment; revocation.
bodyText: After marriage, a premarital agreement may be amended or revoked only by a written agreement signed by the parties. The amended agreement or the revocation is enforceable without consideration.
bodyHtml: [§572D-5]  Amendment; revocation.  After marriage, a premarital agreement may be amended or revoked only by a written agreement signed by the parties.  The amended agreement or the revocation is enforceable without consideration. [L 1987, c 321, pt of §1]
